It includes Sofia's bullets and your line that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

My first channel message said you could send it from your drafts folder. That was wrong, and I posted two corrections. To get it to June, you or Sofia would need to write it again in your own mail using the text from my draft. I can't confirm from here that June has it.
